strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Sofwea blong salem stok long trak mo sales rep
strings.tierB.home.description: Sofwea blong distribiuta: invois mo risit long fon blong rep, stok long trak, kolektem mani, rod mo visit. I wok nomata i nogat intanet, mo i sendem afta.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Lukaotem ol sales rep blong yu, stat long fes visit go kasem las mani we oli kolektem
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales i wan klaod platfom (cloud) blong ol kampani blong distribiusen mo holsel we oli gat ol sales rep long rod, wetem salem stok long trak (van sales). Ol rep oli mekem mo printim invois mo risit long fon blong olgeta, oli lukaotem stok long trak mo oli rekodem ol visit, mo ol manija oli luk ol sel, mani we oli kolektem mo kaon blong ol kastoma long sem taem we i hapen.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invois long fon blong rep
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Rep i mekem invois long doa blong kastoma mo i printim long wan Bluetooth thermal printa bifo hem i livim stoa.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Kolektem mani mo kaon blong kastoma
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Evri pemen i kasem wan risit wetem namba, we i joen wetem ol invois we hem i pem, mo balans mo stetmen blong kastoma i jenis stret long taem ya.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Responsabiliti blong stok long trak
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Stok blong evri trak i stap long rekod, wanwan prodak: wanem oli lodem, salem, ritan mo wanem i stap yet; ale, sapos i gat wan gap, yu luk long sem dei.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Rod mo visit
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Ol visit oli rekodem wetem ples, taem mo foto, mo rod blong evri rep i stap long map blong manija i luk.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: I wok nomata i nogat intanet
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Ol rep oli save salem yet nomata i nogat signal. Ol dokumen oli wet long fon mo oli go otomatik, i no gat dabol, taem intanet i kambak.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Web dashboard blong ol manija
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Sel, mani we oli kolektem, ritan, stok mo wok blong evri rep i stap long wan ples, wetem rol mo pemisen blong evri yusa.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Talem long mifala olsem wanem yu salem
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Askem wan kwot o bukum wan miting. Mifala i lukluk ol rep, rod, prodak mo ol nid blong yu long saed blong invois.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Setemap kampani blong yu
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Putum ol prodak, praes, kastoma mo rep, mo setem kaen mani mo taks reit blong kantri blong yu long setting.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Sendem ol rep oli go long rod
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Ol rep oli instolem app long Android o iPhone blong olgeta, oli lodem trak mo oli stat blong salem, printim mo kolektem mani.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Folem dei long taem we i hapen
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Web dashboard i soem sel, mani we oli kolektem, stok long trak mo ol visit, taem ol rep oli stap yet long rod.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales i wan klaod platfom blong lukaotem ol sales rep long rod long ol kampani blong distribiusen mo holsel. Hem i kavremap salem stok long trak (van sales), salem long rod (route sales), tekem oda fastaem (pre-sales) mo karem stok stret i go long stoa (DSD). Ol rep oli mekem invois, printim, kolektem mani mo rekodem visit long fon blong olgeta, mo ol manija oli folem sel, mani we oli kolektem, stok long trak mo kaon blong ol kastoma long wan web dashboard.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.q: FieldSales i wok taem i nogat intanet?
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Yes. App blong rep i wok yet nomata i nogat intanet: ol rep oli mekem mo printim invois mo risit, oli rekodem visit mo oli putum niufala kastoma, mo evri samting i go otomatik, i no gat dabol, taem intanet i kambak. I gat wan eksepsen long Saudi Arabia: ol kampani we oli switjim on e-invoicing integration oli nidim intanet long taem we oli mekem wan invois o wan ritan.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.q: FieldSales i wok long wanem kantri?
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales i givhan long ol kampani blong distribiusen long evri kantri, Vanuatu tu. Evri kampani i setem kaen mani mo taks reit blong hem long setting, mo ol invois, risit mo ripot oli folem. Hed ofis blong FieldSales i stap long Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, mo mifala i mekem setemap long intanet: tru long miting, WhatsApp mo sapot long longwe.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales i save joen wetem ol sistem blong gavman blong e-invoicing?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Mifala i saportem Phase 2 integration wetem Fatoora platfom blong ZATCA. Hemia i blong ol kampani long Saudi Arabia. Long ol narafala kantri, Vanuatu tu, FieldSales i mekem invois wetem kaen mani mo taks reit blong yu, mo wan joen wetem nasonal sistem blong e-invoicing i stap sapos yu askem, afta we mifala i lukluk wetem yu ol rul blong kantri ya. Mifala i no promes se bae hem i folem ol rul ya aotsaed long Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: App blong FieldSales i stap long wanem lanwis?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Intefes blong FieldSales app i stap long ol lanwis ya nomo: Arabik, Inglis, Franis, Tekis mo Jaenis. I no stap long Bislama. Ol rep mo manija oli save jenisim lanwis blong intefes, mo ol invois we oli printim oli save gat wan seken lanwis klosap long mein lanwis. Ol pej blong websaet long narafala lanwis, olsem pej ya long Bislama, oli transleisen blong givim infomesen nomo long saed blong prodak.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.q: Olsem wanem blong mi stat wetem FieldSales?
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Askem wan kwot, bukum wan miting o sendem mesej long mifala long WhatsApp. Mifala i lanem olsem wanem ol rep blong yu oli wok, afta mifala i givhan long yu blong setemap ol prodak, praes, kastoma mo rep. Ol rep oli instolem app long Android o iPhone, mo ol manija oli yusum web dashboard long eni brausa. Smatfon nomo yu nidim.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Intefes blong FieldSales app i stap long ol lanwis ya nomo: Arabik, Inglis, Franis, Tekis mo Jaenis; Bislama i no stap. Ol pej long narafala lanwis oli eksplenem prodak blong infomesen nomo.
strings.tierB.category.title: Sofwea blong salem stok long trak | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Sofwea blong van mo route sales: rep i printim invois long fon, stok long trak blong wanwan prodak, kolektem mani mo visit. I wok nomata i nogat intanet.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Sofwea blong salem stok long trak, blong ol distribiuta mo holsel kampani
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales i sofwea blong salem stok long trak (van sales) blong ol kampani we ol rep blong olgeta oli salem stok long wan trak long rod evri dei. Rep i lodem trak, i salem long evri stoa, i printim invois, i kolektem mani mo i rekodem ol ritan, long wan app nomo long fon. Manija i luk wanem oli lodem, salem, kolektem mo wanem i stap yet long evri trak.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Sofwea blong salem stok long trak i wanem?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Sofwea blong salem stok long trak, we oli kolem tu cash van o route sales sofwea, i ronem wan fasin blong salem we rep i karem stok long trak mo i salem, i givim, i mekem invois mo i kolektem mani long wan visit nomo. Hem i tekem ples blong ol buk blong pepa invois mo ol fonkol long en blong dei. Hem i rekodem evri sel, pemen mo ritan olsem wan dokumen, ale yu save jekem stok mo mani long sem dei. Long manija, hem i ansarem tri kwestin evri naet: wanem evri rep i salem, wanem evri rep i kolektem, mo wanem i stap yet long evri trak.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Wan dei long rod
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Dei i stat wetem wan lod we oli rekodem, we i kamaot long wehaos i go long trak. Long evri stoa, rep i openem fael blong kastoma, i jusum ol prodak long lis o i skanem barcode, i mekem invois mo i printim long thermal printa. Pemen i go long rekod wetem wan risit, mo ritan i go long rekod wetem risen blong hem. Long en blong dei, samting we i stap yet long trak i gobak long wehaos. Bitwin ol samting ya, manija i save folem sel, mani mo visit blong evri rep long web dashboard, i no nid blong ringim eniwan.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Mekem blong ples we signal i slak
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Ol rod blong distribiusen oli pas long basmen, ol eria blong faktri mo ol vilej we signal i slak. FieldSales app blong rep i kipim ol kastoma, prodak mo praes long fon, ale rep i save mekem mo printim dokumen nomata i nogat intanet. Evri dokumen i gat wan ki we i no sem wetem eni narafala, ale hem i go long seva wan taem nomo, nomata oli traem sendem plante taem. Ol kampani long Saudi Arabia we oli switjim on e-invoicing integration oli nidim intanet long taem we oli mekem invois mo ritan. Blong olgeta tu, risit, visit mo niufala kastoma oli wok yet nomata i nogat intanet.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Kolektem mani mo responsabiliti blong trak
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Mani long rod i nidim sem kontrol olsem stok. Evri mani we oli kolektem i kasem wan risit wetem namba we i save joen wetem ol invois we hem i pem, mo balans blong kastoma i jenis stret long taem ya. Sistem i kaontem stok long trak blong evri prodak: wanem oli lodem, tekemaot wanem oli salem, mo putum ol ritan mo ol adjasmen we oli rekodem; ale ol manija oli save jekem wetem stok we oli kaontem long han bifo rep i go hom. Yu save makem ol ritan olsem nomol, bagarap o jenis, mo manija i disaed sapos ol samting we oli kambak oli save go bak long stok blong salem long trak.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Hem i blong hu?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales i fitim ol distribiuta mo holsel kampani blong ol prodak we oli salem kwik, olsem kakae, dring, prodak blong klinim mo prodak blong lukaotem bodi, mo eni kampani we i gat rep we oli visitim ol stoa long rod. Hem i saportem salem stok long trak, tekem oda fastaem mo karem stok stret i go long stoa. Hem i no wan fulwan ERP: hem i joen wetem akaonting o ERP sistem blong yu long wan API. Ol manija oli disaed wanem evri rep i save mekem, olsem givim diskaon, salem andanit long praes long lis o putum niufala kastoma.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Wanem i difren bitwin salem stok long trak mo tekem oda fastaem?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Long salem stok long trak, rep i karem stok mo long sem visit hem i givim, mekem invois mo kolektem mani. Long tekem oda fastaem, rep i tekem wan oda mo wehaos i karem i go afta. FieldSales i saportem tufala, ale wan kampani i save ronem cash van long sam rod mo tekem oda long ol narafala rod. Long tufala fasin, ol invois, mani mo kaon blong ol kastoma oli stap long sem sistem, mo ol manija oli luk long sem ripot.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Olsem wanem blong jekem wan trak long en blong dei?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales i soem, blong evri prodak long evri trak, hamas oli lodem, salem, ritan mo hamas i stap yet. Jekem namba we i stap yet wetem stok we yu kaontem long han, rekodem eni difren olsem wan adjasmen, mo tekemaot samting we i stap yet i gobak long wehaos long wan muv nomo. Trak i stat nekis dei wetem wan klin balans we yu save gud.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Wanem ekwipmen wan rep blong trak i nidim?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Wan smatfon, Android o iPhone. Sapos yu wantem, yu save yusum wan Bluetooth thermal printa: hem i letem rep i givim kastoma wan invois o risit long pepa. FieldSales i no salem ekwipmen mo i no askem wan spesel brand blong printa. Ol manija oli yusum web dashboard long brausa blong eni kompiuta o fon.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales i save joen wetem akaonting sistem blong mifala?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Yes. FieldSales i givim wan API we i letem akaonting o ERP sistem blong yu i sendem mo kasem kastoma, prodak, invois, risit mo muv blong stok wetem platfom. Tim blong yu o man we i mekem integration i bildim joen ya long API dokumentesen.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales long evri kantri: mani, taks mo e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales i wok blong ol distribiuta long evri kantri. Luk kaen mani, taks mo stetas blong e-invoicing blong evri kantri long wan tebol.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales i givhan long ol kampani blong distribiusen long evri kantri. Evri kampani i jusum kantri, kaen mani mo taks reit blong hem long setting, mo ol invois, risit mo ripot oli folem. E-invoicing integration wetem gavman i wok long Saudi Arabia nomo. Long evri narafala kantri, i stap sapos yu askem. Tebol ya i soem, blong evri kantri, kaen mani blong kantri, taks o VAT reit we oli yusum mostaem, mo sapos joen wetem gavman e-invoicing i wok finis o i stap sapos yu askem.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Mifala i saportem Phase 2 integration wetem Fatoora platfom blong ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Evri kampani i setem kaen mani mo taks reit long setting blong hem. Ol reit long tebol ya oli blong givim aedia nomo mo oli save jenis; jekem ol loa blong naoia wetem man blong advaesem yu long taks. Wan laen (—) i minim se i no gat wan jenerel reit we oli lisim blong kantri ya.
strings.tierB.about.title: Abaot FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales i mekem klaod sofwea blong ol kampani blong distribiusen we oli gat sales rep long rod. FieldSales i stat long 2026 long Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (nem blong hem long Arabik: فيلد سيلز) i wan klaod platfom blong ol kampani blong distribiusen mo holsel we oli gat sales rep long rod. FieldSales i stat long 2026 mo hed ofis blong hem i stap long Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Hem i givhan long ol kampani long evri kantri, mo kaen mani mo taks reit blong evri kantri i stap long setting blong kampani. Ol kastoma blong mifala oli ol kampani we oli salem mo karem stok tru long ol rep long rod: ol distribiuta, holsel kampani mo ol faktri we oli gat ol sales rep mo trak blong olgeta wan.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Mifala i bildim wan sistem we i joenem evri wok long rod: invois we rep i printim long fon, risit mo kaon blong ol kastoma, responsabiliti blong stok long trak, rod mo visit wetem ples mo foto, mo wan web dashboard blong ol manija. App blong rep i wok long Android mo iPhone, i wok yet nomata i nogat intanet, mo i sendem otomatik taem intanet i kambak. Ol kampani oli save joenem FieldSales wetem akaonting o ERP sistem blong olgeta long wan API, ale oli no nid blong raetem tu taem ol infomesen we i kam long rod.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Mifala i talem prodak olsem we hem i stap. Mifala i saportem Phase 2 integration wetem Fatoora platfom blong ZATCA. Integration wetem sistem blong gavman long ol narafala kantri i stap sapos yu askem. Intefes blong app i stap long ol lanwis ya: Arabik, Inglis, Franis, Tekis mo Jaenis; Bislama i no stap. Blong toktok wetem mifala, askem wan kwot, bukum wan miting o sendem mesej long mifala long WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Kontaktem FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Toktok wetem tim blong FieldSales: askem wan kwot, bukum wan miting o toktok long WhatsApp abaot sofwea blong sales rep mo salem stok long trak.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Talem long mifala olsem wanem ol rep blong yu oli salem naoia mo wanem yu wantem jenisim. Askem wan kwot, bukum wan miting o sendem mesej long WhatsApp, mo wan long tim blong mifala bae i ansa. Blong sapot, ol kastoma blong mifala oli save yusum sem rod ya blong kontaktem mifala. I gud sapos yu talem kantri blong yu, hamas rep yu gat, mo sapos oli salem long trak, tekem oda o tufala.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Bukum wan miting long intanet wetem tim blong mifala. Bae mifala i soem wan dei blong rep long app mo dashboard blong manija, wetem ol eksampol we i klosap long ol prodak mo rod blong yu, mo mifala i ansarem ol kwestin blong yu abaot setemap.
